finding.headline: "The Cloth-Nappy Reality Crash"
finding.problem: "I wanted to save money with cloth. Now I'm washing poo at 3am, the leaks ruin his clothes, and I feel like a failure for wanting the disposable. Tell me what's actually sane."
finding.person: Mum who planned reusable nappies to save money; after 3 nights of leaks and laundry mountain, overwhelmed (Classic Kids Care documents this exact Nigerian flip).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module; strong local pain.". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
